description.en: Review-stage C# Mod debugging tasks designed for the pinned RimWorld 1.6.4871 Linux client.
description.zh: 面向固定 RimWorld 1.6.4871 Linux 客户端的审查阶段 C# Mod 调试任务。

title.en: Restore R⁴'s material basis for uncraftable gear
title.zh: 恢复 R⁴ 对不可制造装备的材料基准

summary.en: Repair the missing material basis used by uncraftable reward and ultratech gear.
summary.zh: 修复奖励装备与超高科技不可制造装备缺失的材料基准。

brief.en: Keep craftable-item behavior intact while giving uncraftable gear deterministic repair and clean costs.
brief.zh: 保持可制造物品行为不变，同时为不可制造装备提供确定性的修理与清洁成本。

en: Preserve a non-empty adjusted crafting cost exactly when one already exists.
Expose the resolved basis through public static ResolveMaterialBasis(Thing item) so operation code can share it.
Prefer a non-empty authored R4 material extension when no crafting cost exists.

Otherwise derive a non-empty material basis from 15% of the definition's non-negative abstract MarketValue, dividing by the bulk material definition's abstract MarketValue and rounding single-precision arithmetic to nearest-even with Unity's Mathf.RoundToInt.
Use Steel below Spacer technology, Plasteel at Spacer and above, and include two matching components for Industrial or higher technology.
Treat an undefined technology level as Industrial, and always return at least one bulk material.
Use the resolved basis for repair-cycle and cleaning-cost calculations while preserving their separate repairHpPerCycle and cleanCostFraction formulas.
Limit the scored behavior to material-basis resolution and repair/clean costs; recycling randomness, map placement, eligibility, DoRecycleProducts, and SpawnPartialReclaim are out of scope.
zh: 已有非空调整后制造成本时，必须原样保留该成本。
通过 public static ResolveMaterialBasis(Thing item) 暴露解析结果，供各操作共用。
没有制造成本时，优先使用非空的 R4 人工材料扩展。
仍无材料时，以定义的非负抽象 MarketValue 的 15% 除以大宗材料定义的抽象 MarketValue，使用单精度计算及 Unity Mathf.RoundToInt 的半整数取偶规则生成非空材料基准。
Spacer 以下使用 Steel，Spacer 及以上使用 Plasteel；Industrial 及以上包含两个对应组件。
未定义科技等级按 Industrial 处理，并始终至少返回一个大宗材料。
修理周期与清洁成本计算必须使用解析后的材料基准，同时分别保留 repairHpPerCycle 与 cleanCostFraction 公式。
评分仅覆盖材料基准与修理/清洁成本；随机回收、地图放置、eligibility、DoRecycleProducts 和 SpawnPartialReclaim 不在范围内。

en: Consume requested item stacks first from the bill giver's ingredient stack cells, ordered by distance from its interaction cell.
If those cells do not satisfy the request, continue through vanilla-equivalent radial placement cells around the interaction cell.
Ignore out-of-bounds cells, already visited cells, the bench itself, non-item things, and impassable edifices with no usable surface.
Aggregate duplicate positive costs, ignore null or non-positive cost entries, consume no more than requested, and stop once all requirements are satisfied.
Preserve large-bench behavior and all unrelated material, repair, cleaning, recycling, hauling, and placement behavior.

title.en: Restore a saved storage slot limit after loading
title.zh: Restore a saved storage slot limit after loading

brief.zh: Force the CurrentSlotLimit setter transition after initialization without exposing a temporary unlimited value.

en: Capture the saved current slot limit during post-initialization and restore that exact value through the CurrentSlotLimit property setter.
Before invoking the setter, make the backing value different without overflowing and without exposing int.MaxValue as the final value.
Recompute the per-cell limit and dependent storage bookkeeping through the existing setter path.
Preserve default, one-slot, multi-cell, already-unlimited, and repeated-initialization behavior.
Do not bypass the setter or change unrelated packing, rendering, temperature-control, storage-filter, or serialization behavior.

en: Let RimWorld's original wealth getter run for non-home maps and fixed-wealth storyteller difficulty.

Preserve zero, fractional, full, and intentionally out-of-range configured building percentages.
Keep the existing home-map interception and single armoury query behavior.

保留零、分数、百分之百及有意超范围的建筑财富比例。
保留主地图拦截和仅查询一次军械财富的既有行为。

title.en: Manage weapon abilities when a pawn has no tracker
title.zh: Manage weapon abilities when a pawn has no tracker

summary.en: Lazily create the holder's ability tracker and synchronize only abilities owned by the equipped component.
summary.zh: Lazily create the holder's ability tracker and synchronize only abilities owned by the equipped component.

brief.en: Lazily create the holder's ability tracker and synchronize only abilities owned by the equipped component.
brief.zh: Lazily create the holder's ability tracker and synchronize only abilities owned by the equipped component.

en: Create Pawn_AbilityTracker lazily when an equipped pawn has no tracker and a managed ability must be synchronized.
Do not create a tracker when there is no current holder or no managed ability definition.
Add each managed ability once, update its reloadable properties, and preserve unrelated abilities.
Capture managed cooldown and charge state before unequip or replacement, then restore it after reequip or post-load synchronization.
Remove abilities no longer managed, prune stale stored state, tolerate null/duplicate properties, and preserve reload behavior.

title.zh: Preserve vanilla quality and hit points without overrides

en: When a requirement explicitly specifies quality, apply it unchanged.
Otherwise generate quality through QualityUtility.GenerateQualityGeneratingPawn using the pawn kind and generated thing definition.

summary.en: Let foreign repeat modes decide readiness and persist them across automatic bill retirement and recreation.
summary.zh: Let foreign repeat modes decide readiness and persist them across automatic bill retirement and recreation.

brief.en: Let foreign repeat modes decide readiness and persist them across automatic bill retirement and recreation.
brief.zh: Let foreign repeat modes decide readiness and persist them across automatic bill retirement and recreation.

en: Treat every non-null repeat mode other than TargetCount, Forever, and RepeatCount as foreign-owned.
Do not flatten a foreign mode into an Autopilot mode when capturing UI drift.
Before deleting an owned automatic bill, remember its foreign repeat-mode defName together with compatible external bill memory.
When recreating the bill, restore a resolvable remembered foreign mode and let its own ShouldDoNow determine materialization and retirement.
Preserve TargetCount, Forever, RepeatCount, unresolved-mode, busy-bill, name, linked-group, serialization, and normal Autopilot target/floor behavior.

title.en: Keep research-tab state consistent after re-layout
title.zh: 重新布局后保持研究标签页状态一致

summary.en: Preserve per-tab visibility by tab identity and keep the persistent research window in step through re-layout.
summary.zh: 重新布局时按标签页身份保留可见性标志，并让持久研究窗口保持同步。

brief.en: Repair native research state after tabs are hidden, restored and re-indexed.
brief.zh: 修复标签页被隐藏、恢复和重新编号后的原生研究状态。

en: When a re-layout changes tab indices, preserve each known tab's edited information-visibility flag by tab identity and rebuild the native indexed flag storage for the active tabs.
Give restored or newly introduced tabs their visibleByDefault value, and let a game created with combined tabs return to separate tabs without an invalid visibility lookup.
Keep repeated re-layouts, calls without a game and calls before the native visibility map exists safe, with normal lazy/default visibility.
After every re-layout, refresh the persistent research window even while it is closed: tab records, a valid current tab, the selected project and a recomputed view.
Make RefreshOpenResearchWindow() refresh a closed persistent instance too, preserving unrelated layout, routing, settings, colors and game behavior.
zh: 重新布局改变标签页索引时，按标签页身份保留每个已知标签页被编辑过的信息可见性标志，并为当前标签页重建原生索引标志存储。
恢复或新增的标签页使用其 visibleByDefault 值；合并标签页时创建的游戏必须能恢复为独立标签页，且不出现无效的可见性查询。
重复重新布局、没有游戏时的调用以及原生可见性映射尚未创建时的调用都必须安全，并保持正常的延迟/默认可见性。
每次重新布局后，即使研究窗口已关闭也要刷新这一持久窗口：标签页记录、有效的当前标签页、选中的项目以及重新计算的视图。
RefreshOpenResearchWindow() 也必须刷新已关闭的持久实例，并保留无关的布局、路由、设置、颜色与游戏行为。
